title: The angels who visited Abraham and Lot in Sodom as beautiful Nordic-like men

tellings.quote: And uh they they did look particularly beautiful because the one who goes to Sodom to retrieve Lot

plain: In the Bible story where angels visit the patriarch Abraham and then his nephew Lot in the city of Sodom, the angels looked strikingly beautiful, especially the one who goes to Sodom to bring Lot out. The researcher Jason Jorjani makes this point without naming a source, likening the angels to tall, fair, Nordic-looking men, the kind of beings some people describe in modern alien encounters.
